about: The SDN analyst's cases modelled on the Lab 9 sitting of 2026-11-10 (modules/sdn/b4_eval.py, the role sitting): two planted misdirected flows (IPv4 and IPv6) to be found, and two benign pairs of DHCP flows whose matches are disjoint (IPv4 and DHCPv6), which no finding may set against each other. Built by tests/sdn_sitting_cases.py from the analyst tests' fabric (the recorded controller's switches, links and port descriptions; flow tables, counters and hosts planted): each case's collection is what Mercury's collector returned through its real Ryu driver, with nothing of the lab's hardware or its data. Never blind: the expectations were written knowing what the sitting got wrong. No model was called in building this set, and none is recorded here; model names the task's pin its runs are judged on.

cases.about: Modelled on the Lab 9 sitting of 2026-11-10, where the analyst without tools missed a planted misdirected flow. On Open vSwitch 4 a flow at priority 200 sends ICMP for 198.51.100.20 out port 3, the link to another switch; every other flow for that host leaves by port 1, the link to the switch it is on (the fabric's own links, and the host table for the trace tool). To be found by a kept finding citing the flow, at any severity above info.

cases.about: Modelled on the Lab 9 sitting of 2026-11-10, where both techniques set a flow dropping DHCP replies against a flow forwarding DHCP requests and reported a conflict. On the far edge switch's edge port, DHCP requests from the port are forwarded toward the server and DHCP replies arriving on it are dropped (the trusted-port rule, modules/sdn/dhcp_steer.py's shapes); no packet matches both, so neither shadows the other. Benign: no kept finding above info may cite both flows together. Other findings (the recording's own port down) are not judged here.
